description: Send the user's answer to a question the maker (vendor) asked about a UFP order — get_order_status surfaces an open question when one is waiting. Confirm the answer with the user before sending. The network relays it: the maker sees plain text from the network account with the user's contact details and links stripped, so never include emails, phone numbers, or URLs the answer depends on.

message.description: The user's answer, in their words — it is relayed to the maker

order_id.description: The UFP order the maker asked about (ord_…)
